title.zh: 枪支、爆炸物与武器管制（动物管理——豁免）命令 2025
title.en: Guns, Explosives and Weapons Control (Animal Management — Exemption) Order 2025

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Guns, Explosives and Weapons Control (Animal Management — Exemption) Order 2025 and comes into operation on 1 July 2025.

heading.en: Licence not needed to possess defined weapon

text.en: 4. Each of the individuals in paragraph 3 is exempt from the requirement in section 29(1) of the Act for carrying, handling or otherwise having in the individual’s possession a defined weapon for the individual’s use in the exercise or discharge of the individual’s powers or duties under written law for an animal management purpose, including sedating an animal preparatory to, or consequential on, carrying out that animal management purpose.

heading.en: Licence not needed to convey defined weapon

text.en:
5. Each of the individuals in paragraph 3 is exempt from the requirement in section 32(1) of the Act for conveying a defined weapon —
(a)to any place in Singapore on a journey wholly within Singapore; and
(b)in a vehicle by road or a vessel by water, or both, which is driven, ridden or piloted (as the case may be) by the individual,
for and in the exercise or discharge at that place of the individual’s powers or duties under written law for an animal management purpose, including sedating an animal preparatory to, or consequential on, carrying out that animal management purpose.
